partner.result_used: Gaussian-mixture BV/inverse-half-scale fragmentation barrier and smooth random-center family

new_results.statement: For every Borel map F:R^n->R, the optimal interval-density constant over arbitrary cap-one product laws equals exactly the optimal constant over C_c^infinity cap-one probability densities. In particular the full QFORM optimal constant is unchanged.
There are smooth compact cap-one densities h_N whose L1 distance from every Gaussian location-scale mixture with E T^{-1/2}<=sqrt(2pi) is at least 1-2/N.

For the partner random-center law and Q_N=2X1X2+2X3X4, spectrum {1,-1,1,-1}, the true whole-law density is <=4 uniformly, whereas the component-first Gaussian conditional certificate is (I3*2^(2/3)/pi)N^2 = 1.48678636... N^2.

safe_next_step: Work entirely on smooth compact cap-one marginals, seeking a whole-marginal replacement for inverse Gaussian scale in the determinant/Cauchy-Binet proof. Do not normalize remote active fragments before the smoothing mechanism; partner BV barrier rules out latent-scale-only closure.
